note: No Bible verse is quoted in the source (Matthew 28:20 does not appear in this bio); references is empty. Livingstone's Cambridge appeal, the 'forward' letter, the 'open sore' sentence and the 'Fear God and work hard' motto are his words, translated as prose.

Forms aligned with the shipped sw corpus and the existing david-livingstone.faq.json: Chama cha Umisionari cha London, Kanisa Kuu la Westminster, “piecer” (kept in English, as in the FAQ), Mosi-oa-Tunya “moshi unaonguruma”, biashara ya utumwa ya Waarabu na Waswahili, kidonda kilichowazi cha dunia, Dkt Livingstone, nadhani?, Chifu Chitambo, mabwawa ya Bangweulu, Ujiji, Mto Naili, Rasi (the Cape). The open-sore prayer follows the FAQ's rendering. Universities’ Mission to Central Africa kept in English as an institution name (as China Inland Mission is in the C. T. Studd bio).
Victoria Falls is not named in the English (only 'renamed them for his queen'), so the name Maporomoko ya Victoria was not added.

Clock times: per house rule the printed hours are kept — 'from six in the morning until eight at night' => 'kuanzia saa sita asubuhi hadi saa nane usiku'. Reviewer: in Swahili time-reckoning this reads as noon to 2 a.m.; the shipped FAQ for this author converts to 'saa kumi na mbili asubuhi hadi saa mbili usiku'. Consider switching for reader clarity.
Shipped sw FAQ inconsistency (not this file): david-livingstone.faq.json says Sechele was baptised in 1849; the English bio and the historical record say 1848 (1 October 1848). This bio follows 1848.

Translated the corrected fact: Livingstone was ordained 20 November 1840 and sailed on the George on 8 December 1840, so 'mwezi uliofuata' (the following month), not the English 'that same month'. The same slip in the English bio/FAQ and the am/es/fr/pt editions (and the sw FAQ) is reported for a separate fix.
